therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Tumor angiogenesis and growth factor signaling inhibition
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients with advanced urothelial carcinoma post chemotherapy
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Percentage of participants that experience progression by 6 months

safety_signals: Death not associated with CTCAE term (5/42 sunitinib vs 3/28 placebo)
Infection with Grade 3 or 4 neutrophils (2/42 sunitinib vs 1/28 placebo)
results.dose_information: 50 mg PO once daily for four consecutive weeks with a two week rest period
